targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-867 (evidence successor to V3-EXQ-844, first behavioural-effect test of SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition after its 2026-08-01 build): the substrate gap 844 identified is CLOSED (harm_bias()/select_harm_aware_leaves() implemented, wired, default-off/bit-identical confirmed by 32 pre-existing + 11 new contracts). But this run's own P0 precondition harm_bias_engages FAILED on ARM_SELECTION_ON: decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero=0 and decomp_n_harm_override_fires=0 across all 6 seeds and both arms -- the harm-aware bias never fired even once, so ARM_SELECTION_ON and ARM_SELECTION_OFF produced bit-identical action sequences on the 3 neither_decompose seeds and no measurable divergence anywhere (self-route manipulation_inert_or_unmatched, correctly diagnosed by the driver's own readiness gate design). Root cause: the run used the default env with no SD-029 scheduled_external_hazard tuning, so z_harm_a_norm apparently never cleared decomposition_harm_threat_floor=0.1 -- consistent with the already-documented SD-037/V3-EXQ-620 finding that the untuned 'fishtank baseline' produces near-zero z_harm_a signal (pooled distributions all 0.0 across all 6 measured quantities). Not a substrate ceiling, not an implementation gap, not evidence bearing on MECH-321's harm-aware-selection question -- the manipulation never got a chance to engage. Recommend same-question re-queue (867a) applying the SD-029 hazard-density overlay already specified in SD-037's Phase 1b plan (scheduled_external_hazard_enabled=True, interval=20, prob=0.7, adjacent_only=True; hazard_harm 0.05->0.2; proximity_harm_scale 0.1->0.2), with a cheap preflight assertion that decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero>0 in a pilot rollout before committing to the full 6-seed design (mirroring the class of preflight gate V3-EXQ-862 added for dACC engagement). pending_retest_after_substrate is not the right flag here (substrate is ready); this is pending_retest_after_env_tuning.

learning_extracted: SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition's build closed 844's structural gap correctly -- the readiness/precondition design (P_HARM_BIAS_ENGAGES) worked exactly as intended, catching an inert manipulation before it could produce a false verdict either direction.

Building the mechanism does not by itself guarantee the environment presents enough of the triggering condition (hazard exposure) for the mechanism to be exercised -- an environment-adequacy check is a distinct readiness gate from an implementation-completeness check, and this run demonstrates why both are needed.

The SD-029 scheduled_external_hazard-tuned overlay documented in SD-037's Phase 1b plan is the known, already-built fix for this exact class of under-hazard-density baseline env -- no new substrate or environment code is needed, only applying an existing config overlay.
